about: A Guide-style short on Wang Bi (the user, 2026-09-30: "can you help come up with a Wang Bi 'hitchhikers guide to the universe' style short? that might be fun."). A handheld book-device shows its entry on the I Ching in flat, cheerful animation; a narrator reads it dry. Our own device and lines: no DON'T PANIC, towels or Guide logo. Draft 1, for Astra's review.

voice.name: David
voice.note: Picked by the user 2026-09-30 (https://elevenlabs.io/voices/WdZjiN0nNcik2LBjOHiv): 'a classic nature narrator'. A synthetic voice: this short carries the AI-content label on YouTube and TikTok.

narration.text: The I Ching. A book of sixty-four situations, about three thousand years old.
narration.picture: The device lights up: THE I CHING. Sixty-four hexagrams tile in.

narration.text: For most of that time, people used it to ask about the future.
narration.picture: A tiny figure shakes a pot of yarrow stalks; a question mark floats up.

narration.text: This annoyed a young man called Wang Bi.
narration.picture: A small flat scholar, arms folded. WANG BI 王弼, 226–249.
narration.source: Sanguozhi 28, Pei Songzhi's note (He Shao's biography)

narration.text: He died at twenty-three. By then he had written the commentary China read the book through for centuries.
narration.picture: A candle burns down beside a growing stack of pages.
narration.source: Zhouyi zhu; Kong Yingda's Zhouyi zhengyi (642) is built on it

narration.text: His advice: stop staring at the pictures.
narration.picture: The device zooms into Qian: a dragon, a horse, a cart losing its spokes.

narration.text: A picture, he said, is a fish trap. It is there to catch the fish. Once you have the fish, you can put the trap down.
narration.picture: A wicker trap, a fish; the fish is lifted out, the trap set aside.
narration.source: Zhouyi lüeli, Ming xiang: 象者，意之筌也 (the image is the fish trap of the meaning), after Zhuangzi 26

narration.text: If the meaning is strength, what do you need the horse for?
narration.picture: The horse fades; the word STRENGTH stays.
narration.source: Zhouyi lüeli, Ming xiang: 義苟在健，何必馬乎

narration.text: The fish, in this case, is judgment: what a sensible person does in the situation in front of them.
narration.picture: The tiny figure from before, now at a fork in a road, thinking.

narration.text: Recommended for: anyone about to decide something. Not recommended for: finding out what happens next.
narration.picture: The entry's footer, typed. Then the ivory close.

onScreenChinese: 得意忘象 grasp the meaning, forget the image
